headcount_info: c.1,600 employees across London HQ and fulfilment sites (LinkedIn Oct 2025)
ownership_model: Venture-backed private company (Perwyn, SoftBank Vision Fund, Fidelity)
product_summary: Subscription and one-off meal kit boxes with 200+ weekly recipes
Ambient and chilled grocery add-ons via the Gousto Market
Digital recipe discovery with personalised recommendations in-app
mission_snippet: "To reinvent the evening meal" by making home cooking more joyful, convenient, and sustainable.
go_to_market_notes: Direct-to-consumer website and mobile app with weekly meal plan selection
Free delivery for subscription plans; pay-per-box for on-demand customers
Heavy reliance on referral codes, introductory offers, and influencer partnerships
operating_model_insights: Four automated fulfilment centres (Warrington, Thurrock, North Lincolnshire, Staffordshire) picking 8 million meals a month
Factory API orchestrates recipe builds and real-time inventory routing
Customer service split between UK-based teams and outsourced partners handling refunds, substitutions, and late deliveries
pain_point_indicators: Trustpilot reviews frequently cite delayed courier drops, missing ingredients, and produce quality issues (Sept–Oct 2025 scan)
Refund credits and make-good vouchers materially impact margin (estimated £16m FY2024, internal benchmarks)
Menu complexity (200 recipes per week) drives planning pressure on procurement and packaging lines
tech_stack_notes: In-house Factory API and orchestration layer written in Python/Go, underpinned by AWS
Data platform built on Snowflake and dbt, surfaced through Looker and Mode dashboards
Customer engagement via Braze, Iterable, and Segment; support handled in Zendesk with macros
data_assets: Recipe-level demand, waste, and substitution logs per site
Customer order history, meal ratings, pause/resume behaviour, and complaints
Courier telemetry (planned vs actual delivery, exception codes, temperature breaches)
regulatory_notes: UK Food Standards Agency HACCP requirements for chilled goods
DEFRA plant health and allergen labelling compliance
ICO GDPR and PECR obligations for customer data and marketing consent
